creatures.name: Puffgrub
creatures.flavor: Rolls through the grass eating grass, offering nothing, fearing everything.

behaviour.idle: Grazes in the open, oblivious to everything but the ground in front of it, never watching for you.
behaviour.when_locked: Bolts the instant the lock lands, sprinting flat-out in a straight line for open ground - no zig-zag, no doubling back, no fighting back, just flight.

creatures.name: Scrawny Thumper
creatures.flavor: All knuckles and no neck, it complains right up until it doesn't.

behaviour.idle: Grazes and shoulders through the undergrowth in a slow, heavy patrol, rarely breaking into a run unless you get close.
behaviour.when_locked: Bolts in short, lumbering bursts rather than a clean sprint - it can't outrun you, so it barrels through cover and obstacles, crashing off anything in its path and zig-zagging clumsily whenever you close the gap.

behaviour.when_locked: Explodes into frantic, erratic zig-zag leaps the instant the lock lands, changing direction on every bound to spoil your pounce timing.

behaviour.when_locked: Panics and flees in a straight zig-zag, trying to put obstacles or distance between itself and your facing cone, doubling back if it gets cornered.

behaviour.when_locked: Weaves through the nearest cover in tight zig-zags, ducking behind obstacles and doubling back to break your line of sight.

creatures.name: Scrawny Greymaw
creatures.flavor: Doesn't have a weak side, and hates that you keep looking for one.

behaviour.idle: Wanders with an unusually confident, unhurried gait for prey, favouring open ground over cover.
behaviour.when_locked: Hesitates a beat before bolting, then flees in wide zig-zag arcs, shouldering through smaller creatures that get in its way.

creatures.name: The Knucklebreaker
creatures.flavor: Picks a fight with the ground first, just to prove it can lose and get up anyway.

behaviour.territory: Holds a fixed patch of its pocket and doesn't wander from it, squaring up to face you the moment you cross into its range rather than giving ground.
behaviour.wind_up: Plants itself and squares its whole body toward you, a long, visible brace before it closes the last distance and pounces - the biggest, slowest-committing tell in the pocket, and murderous if you walk into it anyway.

creatures.name: The Redline Ripper
creatures.flavor: Hits top speed somewhere between your first step back and your last.

behaviour.territory: Prowls a tight loop at the heart of its pocket, closing distance the instant you're inside its range instead of waiting for you to approach.
behaviour.wind_up: Coils low and holds it, then covers the remaining ground in one committed, explosive leap the moment the wind-up ends.

creatures.name: The Deadeye Warden
creatures.flavor: Already locked onto you before you noticed the grass move.

behaviour.territory: Holds well back at the edge of its range, repositioning to keep you inside its facing cone rather than closing in.
behaviour.wind_up: Freezes and levels its whole body at you from far outside the range most creatures would need - the wind-up is long, but it starts from a distance you won't see coming.

creatures.name: The Throatgrin
creatures.flavor: You won't hear it coming. You'll just stop being able to breathe.

behaviour.territory: Slips between the pocket's cover, holding its range loosely and repositioning rather than standing still.
behaviour.wind_up: Feints a shift in direction before settling into its wind-up, and its neighbours peel off toward you the moment it locks on.

creatures.name: The Ashmaw
creatures.flavor: Doesn't have a specialty. Doesn't need one.

behaviour.territory: Holds the centre of its pocket like it owns the ground, and doesn't give an inch of range when you close in.
behaviour.wind_up: Rises up before it winds up, and everything else nearby turns to converge on you the instant it does.

creatures.name: The Mudking
creatures.flavor: Rules a puddle like an ocean, and will drown you just to prove the point.

behaviour.arena: Found in a deep marsh hollow, holding the reedy shallows and mud banks at its edge rather than the open water - close enough to the shore that something with no fins can still pick the fight.
behaviour.opening: The moment you commit to the fight, the hollow's other occupants start converging on your position from the surrounding reeds and channels.
behaviour.wind_up: Rears back in the water and holds, a full-bodied brace before it surges at you - it does not break off and does not flee, no matter how the fight goes.

creatures.name: The Cragfather
creatures.flavor: Older than the rocks it squats on, meaner than every single one of them.

behaviour.arena: Holds a low rocky outcrop at the foot of the climb, squatting on bare rock anything can walk up to - it never retreats onto the high ground its own claws would open.
behaviour.opening: Committing to the fight draws the outcrop's other occupants up the rocks toward you from every side.
behaviour.wind_up: Digs in and braces against the rock before launching down at you - it stands its ground through the whole exchange and never turns to run.

creatures.name: The Frostback
creatures.flavor: Grew a second hide out of spite for the cold, then started collecting more.
creatures.habitat: the foothills, below the lethal cold line

behaviour.arena: Holds the mountain foothills below the cold line, patrolling a fixed stretch rather than roaming it.
behaviour.opening: Engaging it brings the foothills' other grazer-hunters closing in from the slopes around you.
behaviour.wind_up: Squares up and holds its ground through a long brace before charging - it fights the whole exchange out and never bolts.

creatures.name: The Cinderjaw
creatures.flavor: Breathes the vent like air and looks at you like lunch.

behaviour.arena: Holds a volcanic vent along the shore, never drifting far from the seam it lives on.
behaviour.opening: Starting the fight draws the vent's other occupants in from across the shore to converge on you.
behaviour.wind_up: Glows brighter along its seam as it winds up, holding the brace until it commits to the pounce - it never breaks and run, fighting to the end.

creatures.name: Bonelord of the Trampled Fields
creatures.flavor: All knuckles and no neck, it complains right up until it doesn't.

behaviour.emergence: At the warning, the lair's den lights and the ground trembles as an audio cue rises - then, after a short grace period, the Yellow Alpha bursts out and starts hunting you across the biome.
behaviour.hunt: It closes on you at a flat, relentless pace no amount of running shakes - every prey and grazer in the biome bolts for the edges the instant it wakes, and the ground stays empty while it lives.
behaviour.tell: Squares its whole body toward you and holds a long, heavy brace before it closes and slams down - the biggest tell of any hunter you've faced, and the hardest hit.

creatures.name: Quickfang of the Trampled Fields
creatures.flavor: Twitchy legs, empty head, gone before you blink twice.

behaviour.emergence: The lair lights up and the ground shakes at the warning, and after the grace period the Red Alpha erupts and starts hunting you across the biome.
behaviour.hunt: It never stops closing, no matter how far or fast you run, and the biome around you has already emptied - prey and grazers fled the instant it woke.
behaviour.tell: Coils low for a beat before covering huge ground in a single committed leap - miss the window to punish the wind-up and it's already on you.

creatures.name: Deadeye of the Trampled Fields
creatures.flavor: One good eye and a better trigger; useless the second you're inside its arms.

behaviour.emergence: Den lights and trembling ground announce the warning, and once the grace period passes the Blue Alpha comes hunting you across the biome.
behaviour.hunt: It keeps its distance and stalks your position from range, closing only enough to keep you in its cone, and the biome has already gone quiet around you.
behaviour.tell: Freezes and locks its whole body toward you from far outside normal range, holding the pose through a long wind-up before it pounces the distance closed.

creatures.name: Nightthroat of the Trampled Fields
creatures.flavor: Slinks in, bites once, forgets to leave a body.

behaviour.emergence: The ground trembles and the lair lights at the warning; after the grace period the Purple Alpha slips out hunting you across the biome.
behaviour.hunt: It repositions constantly rather than charging straight in, closing the gap in short bursts, while the emptied biome offers nowhere to restock on healing.
behaviour.tell: Feints a shift in direction, settles into its brace, and holds it before darting the last distance to pounce.

creatures.name: Greytyrant of the Trampled Fields
creatures.flavor: Doesn't have a weak side, and hates that you keep looking for one.

behaviour.emergence: Den lights, trembling ground and the rising cue mark the warning; when the grace period ends the Grey Alpha emerges hunting you across the biome.
behaviour.hunt: It closes on you with the same relentless flat pace as every Alpha, strong on every axis at once, in a biome already emptied of everything that could have healed you.
behaviour.tell: Rises up and holds through a long, total-body brace before it closes and pounces with everything it has.

creatures.name: The Main Course
creatures.flavor: You spent five biomes learning how to eat. Nothing has ever eaten it back.

behaviour.emergence: It lies dormant and unseen in the Ascension domain, never stirring for anything less - the instant your Bestiary record crosses its threshold, wherever you are and whatever you're doing, even mid-hunt for another form, it wakes.
behaviour.hunt: Once awake it hunts you across the whole Ascension domain rather than any one corner of it - there is no safe stretch of the summit left once it is moving, and it does not return to dormancy while you're alive.
behaviour.tell: Commits to a slower, heavier wind-up than anything else in the game before its pounce - hold your ground through it and punish it like any other, but walk away unpunished and it simply keeps coming.
